meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过提问了解你的工作,替你设计并安装一套专属笔记模式(含观察类型与标签),可选配置 Telegram 提醒,最后重启并验证生效。
howto.when: 当你说要定制 claude-mem 记住的内容、创建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签等时触发(即使你没说“模式”两个字)。

say.text: 我想为法律学习建个模式,记录案例规则和考试陷阱。
say.note: Claude 会开始采访你并设计分类。

say.text: 给 claude-mem 加 Telegram 提醒,记到‘事故’标签时通知我。
say.note: 它会引导你配置 Telegram 和触发条件。

say.text: 帮我把现在的模式改成只记实验结论和数据变化。
say.note: 它会提出新分类并重新安装。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude interviews you about your work, designs and installs a custom note-taking mode (observation types and tags), optionally configures Telegram alerts, then restarts and verifies it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or modify a mode, add observation types or tags, etc.—even if you don't say 'mode'.

say_en.text: I want a legal-study mode that records case rules and exam traps.
say_en.note: Claude will interview you and design the taxonomy.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram alert to claude-mem when it records the 'incident' tag.
say_en.note: It will guide you through Telegram setup and triggers.

say_en.text: Change my current mode to only record experiment outcomes and data changes.
say_en.note: It will propose a new taxonomy and reinstall the mode.
